cases.name: Playwright adapter drives exact native locators and preserves explicit operation timeouts
explicit navigation rejects foreign origins and credentials and detects redirects after navigation was attempted
ambiguous or absent action targets never dispatch a native click
deterministic checks return observed booleans and count zero without inventing elements
unsupported targets keys and oversized fills fail before native interaction
observation reads only body ARIA and rejects incomplete oversized UTF-8 content
cancelled setup closes a late context and never touches the supplied browser
caller cancellation closes an in-flight owned context and fences late native effects
a setup deadline closes a context whose page promise completes too late
native failures and cleanup failures expose finite codes rather than private driver messages
closing one adapter is idempotent and leaves another context and consumer browser usable
locators are inert and exact deterministic actions change independently observed app state
invalid options fail before constructing a driver
executor actions return fresh bounded observations for a genuinely sequential journey
an absent executor reports setup required instead of pretending a semantic step passed
unknown blocked or mode-inappropriate executor outcomes fail closed
semantic assertions always execute live and failed assertions remain failed steps
assertion mode cannot mutate even when an executor catches the attempted action error
concurrent operations on one session are rejected rather than silently queued
concurrent executor actions cannot consume a second action or hide their failure
an executor cannot report done while one of its owned actions is still pending
manual and executor actions share one action budget without extra dispatch
agent action and assertion calls share an explicit agent-step budget
cancelled setup closes a driver that arrives later and never opens a usable session
setup has an owned deadline and a late driver is still cleaned exactly once
session and step deadlines fence late executor results and their saved action callbacks
a synchronous executor cannot acknowledge success after blocking past its monotonic deadline
caller cancellation stops a pending executor and prevents its later action dispatch
closing pending work cancels it reports incompleteness and closes only once
idle cancellation and session expiry remain terminal failures at every close
cleanup failures and deadlines remain finite visible outcomes
evidence is detached frozen and redacted while preserving a failed awaited step
agent success semantic verdicts value checks and close do not qualify replay records
a semantic assertion preserves pending actions but only a later deterministic check records them
an already true unrelated check cannot cache an action when the observed UI did not change
a later successful locator check enables replay in a fresh journey without an executor
manual intervention or a fill prevents pending actions from becoming replayable
replay divergence after dispatch cannot repeat the action through a live executor
replay is bound to explicit scope and starting UI while assertions remain live
exact scope goal and UI strings distinguish isolated UTF-16 units from Unicode replacement characters
the actual Vitest fixture lazily owns setup use teardown and safe host metadata
direct body failures survive cleanup and recorded Vitest failures remain runner owned
cleanup failure after a successful body remains visible and excludes raw driver errors
body cleanup and evidence callback failures are all preserved without replacing the body verdict
an evidence callback failure is visible after cleanup and caller cancellation reaches setup
